name: Cynthia L. Ciancio
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Cynthia L. Ciancio, is a founding shareholder of Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C . and she heads up the firm's family law group consisting of 18 attorneys and 6 paralegals. Cynthia’s practice specializes in high profile and complex divorce matters, including high net worth clients, high asset divorces, grey divorces, divorces involving businesses, and the occasional high conflict custody matter. Cynthia is a certified mediator, and she and Loren Brown own a separate business called Divorce Resolutions that handles nothing but family law mediations and arbitrations for represented and unrepresented parties. Cynthia is going on her 28 th year as an attorney, with 25 of those years practicing family law exclusively. She began her career as a Deputy District Attorney in Adams County and gives credit to that office for providing her with top-notch courtroom/litigation skills. Cynthia is known for her dedication to the practice, her many years of volunteer work on various boards especially boards and committees dedicated to educating family law judicial officers and practitioners, and she is especially proud of her work managing the bi-annual update of the Domestic Relations Bench Bar Book - the go to manual for family law in Colorado. Cynthia is also known for her creativity in negotiations, her ability to be a tough advocate when that’s needed, and her no-nonsense – tell it like it is - approach to advising her clients and dealing with opposing counsels. Cynthia is respected by her peers, clients, and judicial officers throughout the state of Colorado. This has earned her a fellowship in Colorado’s Chapter of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and it has led to her being named a Super Lawyer (including Top 100 and Top 50 Women) 15 years in a row, Best Lawyer (Family Law) many times over, and 5280 Top Lawyer – numerous years in a row. Cynthia practices throughout Colorado and continues to serve as a member on the Executive Counsel of the Colorado Bar Association's Family Law Section, and as a Fellow of the AAML.
honors: Recipient of the ABBA Amicus Award , 2005
The Primo Award of Excellence: Service to the Community Award, 2012
Recipient of the Adams/Broomfield Bar Association's Volunteer Attorney of the Year Award, 2001

Cynthia was named a Top Women Lawyers finalist by Law Week Colorado, in 2010 & 2011.
